title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has attracted increasing interest as a possible route to construct feature representations that are difficult to reproduce with classical models. However, near-term QML architectures based on trainable parametrized quantum circuits remain affected by limited hardware resources, noise, and severe optimization difficulties such as barren plateaus. In this work we propose Soft-MoQE, a Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts architecture that replaces variational quantum training with the input-dependent selection and combination of fixed quantum feature maps. The model is composed of a heterogeneous pool of non-trainable quantum circuits, each defining a distinct embedding, and a classical gating network that learns how to weight these embeddings for each data point. translated_title: 面向混合量子-经典学习的软量子专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习（QML）作为构建经典模型难以复现的特征表示的一种可能途径，正受到日益增长的关注。然而，基于可训练参数化量子电路的近期QML架构仍然受到硬件资源有限、噪声以及贫瘠高原等严重优化困难的制约。在本工作中，我们提出了Soft-MoQE，一种软量子专家混合架构，它以依赖于输入的固定量子特征映射的选择与组合来替代变分量子训练。该模型由一组异构的不可训练量子电路池（每个电路定义一种独特的嵌入）以及一个经典门控网络组成，后者学习如何为每个数据点对这些嵌入进行加权。我们在三个经PCA降维的任务上对Soft-MoQE进行了基准测试：MNIST奇偶校验、MNIST十分类和FashionMNIST。Soft-MoQE的表现优于单个最佳专家以及……
tldr: 提出Soft-MoQE架构，用经典门控网络对固定的不可训练量子特征映射进行输入自适应的选择与加权组合，从而避开变分量子训练中贫瘠高原等优化难题，并在MNIST和FashionMNIST任务上优于单个最佳量子专家。
en_tdlr: Soft-MoQE replaces variational quantum training with a classical gating network that input-dependently selects and combines fixed, non-trainable quantum feature maps, outperforming the single best quantum expert on benchmark classification tasks.
